notes:
Dahu 0.97.0 beta for Windows

Changes since 0.94.2:
- New/Open asks to save unsaved work. New starts fresh with default views and a clean Undo history.
- Large-file loading uses chunked transfers instead of the fixed 24 MB source-file limit. Escape cancels transfer; native geometry conversion still requires waiting.
- Fit model resets framing even with no visible objects, in the active view or all views.
- Fixed perspective grid on the CPlane and smoothly adaptive parallel grids. View > Grid settings controls minimum spacing, extent and major lines. Visible lines align to Grid Snap without changing snapping precision during zoom.
- Cleaner status bars: recovery-copy status beside the filename, one document-unit picker beside Grid Snap, compact selection counts and navigation help in a tooltip.

Validation: 148 automated checks plus isolated Windows desktop and updater checks. Valid signatures are accepted; altered signatures are rejected.
Real 4K performance validation on the Dell XPS 15 9520 remains open. Basic SpaceMouse Pro Wireless navigation is user-confirmed; further device tuning remains planned.

Includes the installer, updater signature and corresponding AGPL source archive. The Windows installer is not Authenticode-signed.
